record.context_brief: crossing number of complete bipartite graphs
record.original_question: For the complete bipartite graph K_{m,n}, is the planar crossing number equal to floor(m/2)·floor((m−1)/2)·floor(n/2)·floor((n−1)/2)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $K_{m,n}$ denote the complete bipartite graph with parts of sizes $m$ and $n$. The (planar) crossing number $\operatorname{cr}(G)$ of a graph $G$ is the minimum number of pairwise crossings of edges over all drawings of $G$ in the plane, where edges are drawn as continuous curves, no two edges share more than one point, no three edges cross at a common point, and no edge crosses itself.

Determine whether, for all integers $m, n \geq 1$,
$$\operatorname{cr}(K_{m,n}) \;=\; \left\lfloor \tfrac{m}{2} \right\rfloor \left\lfloor \tfrac{m-1}{2} \right\rfloor \left\lfloor \tfrac{n}{2} \right\rfloor \left\lfloor \tfrac{n-1}{2} \right\rfloor.$$
artifact.status_search_result: This is Zarankiewicz's crossing number conjecture. It is known to hold whenever $\min(m,n) \le 6$, and has been verified for $K_{7,7}, K_{7,8}, K_{7,9}, K_{7,10}, K_{8,8}, K_{8,9}, K_{8,10}$. The Zarankiewicz formula is known to be an upper bound, and the best known lower bound asymptotically gives at least about 83% of the conjectured value. The general conjecture remains open.

status_evidence.title: Turán's brick factory problem - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: The Zarankiewicz conjecture is known to be true for K_{m,n} with m ≤ 6, and for several further small cases; the general case remains open.
status_evidence.claim: General Zarankiewicz conjecture remains open; verified for small cases.

status_evidence.title: Zarankiewicz crossing number conjecture - Encyclopedia of Mathematics
status_evidence.snippet: Conjecture cr(K_{m,n}) = floor(m/2) floor((m-1)/2) floor(n/2) floor((n-1)/2).
status_evidence.claim: Standard statement of the conjecture, listed as open.

status_evidence.title: Turán's Brick Factory Problem: The Status of the Conjectures of Zarankiewicz and Hill
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of partial results and known lower bounds approaching 83% of conjectured value.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress with asymptotic ratio ~0.83; conjecture not resolved in general.
